name: Hellfire, Lesser
body:
School evocation [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F/DF (any unholy symbol or heretical tome)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius burst, 10 ft. high
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Hellish fire bursts forth from the ground and fills the area. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). Half the damage is fire, but the other half results directly from unholy power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by fire resistance. This spell must be centered on the ground.

A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
